جُلَاجِلٌ An ass that brays clearly; (S, K;) as also ↓جُلَالٌ; (El-Moheet, K) which is in like manner applied to a she-camel. (El-Moheet, TA.) ―
-b2- A boy light in spirit; brisk, lively, or sprightly, in his work; (K;) as also ↓ جُلْجُلٌ (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) ＝
-A2- أَبْثَثْتُهُ جُلَاجِلَ نَفْسِى I revealed to him what was agitated in my mind. (Ibn-' Abbád, K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
